newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says will take action if Busang a fraud.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says will take action if Busang a fraud.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Monday the government would take action if the country's laws had been violated over the Busang gold property.

But he said he had not yet seen the report issued by Canadian consultants Strathcona Mineral Resources Ltd which said assays of drill cores from Busang had indicated no commercial gold and that there appeared to have been massive fraud.
Asked about the report, Sudjana told reporters after a meeting of economic ministers on development: "I haven't got the report yet so let us wait."
Asked if the government would take action over the report, he said: "If they violated the law, action will be taken, but let's see."
